clinical_signature: Concordantly reduced VWF:Ag and activity; no specific high-molecular-weight multimer loss
path: A1/A2/D'D3/D4/C-domain/CK: equilibrium MD only where a stable structure exists; splice/nonsense/frameshift/CNV: non-structural evidence
initial_structure_or_data: 7A6O; 3GXB; 6N29; 4NT5; assay-matched Boltz fallback only when no experimental structure exists
core_readouts: module backbone RMSD; secondary-structure retention; local flexibility; domain packing; secretion/clearance phenotypic indices; VWFpp/VWF:Ag; variant class and dosage evidence
smd_policy: no default SMD; A2 force only when force-dependent unfolding is the direct question
caveats: Type 1 is genetically and mechanistically heterogeneous; many variants are better handled by secretion/NMD/CNV evidence than protein MD

clinical_signature: Loss of high-molecular-weight multimers with reduced function
path: A2 folded stability first; D4/C-domain/CK assembly second; VWF73-ADAMTS13 only after model validation
initial_structure_or_data: 3GXB for A2; 4NT5 for CK/CTCK; 7WN3 if downloaded for D'D3-D1D2; Boltz for D4/C-domain only as fallback
structure_tier: experimental-first; A2 and CK are strongest; D4/C-domain predicted models exploratory
core_readouts: A2 RMSD; secondary-structure retention; local flexibility; Tyr1605-Met1606 cleavage-site exposure; multimerization-surface retention; assembly/packing stability
smd_policy: A2 mechanical unfolding is conditional and requires matched WT/pathogenic controls and physical loading rates; no default SMD
interpretation_tier: mechanism-grade for 3GXB A2; exploratory for predicted assembly models
caveats: Type 2A can arise from increased ADAMTS13 susceptibility or multimerization/secretion failure; do not collapse all 2A into A2

clinical_signature: Enhanced platelet binding; low-dose ristocetin hyperresponse; possible thrombocytopenia and loss of high-molecular-weight multimers
path: 7A6O AIM-A1 equilibrium MD and 1SQ0 A1-GPIbα interface MD; retain 1M10 as backup
core_readouts: AIM-A1 contact and salt-bridge retention; A1 binding-face exposure; A1-GPIbα interface contact retention; interface RMSD; minimum distance; contact lifetime
smd_policy: A1-GPIbα unbinding SMD only with matched WT/2B/2M controls and a validated reaction coordinate; old AIM end-to-end SMD is no-go
interpretation_tier: mechanism-grade when matched experimental structures and controls are used
caveats: A1/AIM release alone is not sufficient without platelet-binding phenotype and ristocetin response

clinical_signature: Reduced platelet-dependent function without selective high-molecular-weight multimer loss
path: A1-GPIbα and A3-collagen equilibrium MD; closed-state AIM-A1 as an orthogonal but non-decisive LOF axis
initial_structure_or_data: 1SQ0 and 1M10 for A1-GPIbα; 7A6O for closed A1; 4DMU for A3-collagen
core_readouts: A1-GPIbα contact retention and interface RMSD; A1 binding-face stability; A3-collagen interface contacts and RMSD; collagen-contact lifetime
smd_policy: SMD only after equilibrium MD separates WT/2M/2B and the biological reaction coordinate is explicit
interpretation_tier: mechanism-grade when phenotype excludes 2B and multimer loss; otherwise use as support
caveats: A1 contact loss is an LOF direction, not a 2B-positive direction; A3 variants require collagen-binding phenotype

clinical_signature: Disproportionately low FVIII:C with preserved VWF:Ag and multimers; mimics mild hemophilia A
path: D′D3 folded stability and FVIII-interface geometry; use experimental D′D3/ D′ structures first and build an FVIII complex only with documented docking constraints
initial_structure_or_data: 6N29 for D′D3; 2MHP for D′; experimental FVIII complex structure if available
structure_tier: experimental-first; FVIII complex construction must be separately validated
core_readouts: D′D3 RMSD; local flexibility; FVIII-binding surface retention; interface SASA; residue-pair distance stability; FVIII:C/VWF:Ag discordance
interpretation_tier: mechanism-grade for experimental D′D3/D′ components; complex-level results require explicit model validation
caveats: D′D3-FVIII interface is not adequately represented by a generic protein-protein prediction; distinguish 2N from hemophilia A and combined defects

clinical_signature: Near-absent or absent VWF:Ag and activity
path: NMD, CNV, regulatory, and genotype-phenotype evidence; structure MD only for rare missense residual-expression variants
initial_structure_or_data: variant coordinates; CNV and RNA evidence; no default protein structure
core_readouts: nonsense/frameshift consequence; exon-level deletion/duplication; splice consequence; VWF:Ag level; anti-VWF inhibitor context
interpretation_tier: diagnostic-support via variant mechanism, not MD
caveats: Large deletions and null variants should not be forced into single-domain MD; interpret representation and mosaicism carefully
